definitions.explanation: The color purple, named with {色|いろ} (color) to make clear that the color is meant rather than the plant {紫|むらさき} (gromwell), whose root gave the old purple dye.

examples.japanese: {紫色|むらさきいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{唇|くちびる}→唇：03903_kuchibiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{紫色|むらさきいろ}になった。
examples.english: My lips turned purple from the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{紫色|むらさきいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着|き}られる→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧だった。
examples.english: In old Japan, purple was a special color that only people of high rank could wear.

notes:
Used as a noun, with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before another noun: {紫色|むらさきいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (purple clothes). There is no i-adjective form, unlike ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧ or ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紫色|むらさきいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn purple (of lips, bruises)
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{紫色|むらさきいろ}: light purple
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧{紫色|むらさきいろ}: deep purple

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧: purple — the same color, the shorter everyday word
- ⟦{青紫|あおむらさき}→青紫：23105_aomurasaki⟧: blue-purple, violet
- パープル: purple — used in fashion and product colors
